India, Africa Cannot Remain Underrepresented in UN Security Council: EAM S Jaishankar
External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar has called for reform of the UN Security Council, saying India and Africa cannot remain under represented in global decision-making.
Addressing a gathering at the Adwa Victory Memorial Museum in Addis Ababa, Jaishankar called for fair African representation in both permanent and non-permanent membership and recalled India’s efforts during its 2023 G20 presidency to secure permanent membership for the African Union.
